namedLocations.description: Canada (Canadian French: [kanadɑ] listen ) is a country in the northern part of North America. Its ten provinces and three territories extend from the Atlantic to the Pacific and northward into the Arctic Ocean, covering 9.98 million square kilometres (3.85 million square miles), making it the world's second-largest country by total area. Canada's southern border with the United States, stretching some 8,891 kilometres (5,525 mi), is the world's longest bi-national land border. Its capital is Ottawa, and its three largest metropolitan areas are Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver. As a whole, Canada is sparsely populated, the majority of its land area being dominated by forest and tundra. Consequently, its population is highly urbanized, with over 80 percent of its inhabitants concentrated in large and medium-sized cities, with 70% of citizens residing within 100 kilometres (62 mi) of the southern border. Canada's climate varies widely across its vast area, ranging from arctic weather in the north, to hot summers in the southern regions, with four distinct seasons.

transcript.text: Hello and welcome folks.
In today's video we will walk you through the steps to add departments to your private or be to be store and manage the store customers department wise.
So let's get started.
First of all let's understand what the department means.
Let's say when you are setting up a private store, there may be many departments like HR, Admin, and technical and you want to assign specific employees in a particular department.
Therefore, let's see how easily you can add departments under a private store and how you can assign specific customers under the department.
Just go to Store Management, then click on Store, select the store, click on action and edit.
Here you can see the button named the department.
Just activate it and click on the save button.
As you click on the Save button, you will be able to see the tab of the department.
To add a department, click on the Add button in the Department dashboard.
This helps you to quickly create a department for your store customers.
Under the store drop down, only those stores will be listed for which department module is enabled.
Enter the name of the department that you want to add to the store.
Enter the e-mail ID for the selected department.
All the updates regarding the department activities will be sent to the mentioned e-mail address.
The main function of the cost center is to track the expenses of the department.
This field will be displayed on the department listing page and order information pages like View Order detail, Export Orders, Export Order API and Generate order details report etc.
This field will only appear if the Pay on Limit in Store setting is set to store wise.
Using this store, admin and Site admin can assign pay on account balance to each store.
Enter the credit limit for this specific department next to the field.
You will see the total pay on limit remaining for this store.
Enable the status of the department as active and then click on Save and back.
Similarly, you can create multiple departments as per your requirements.
As of now, there is no limitation for creating departments.
You can also import multiple departments at once using the Import Department feature.
Now let's see how we can add customers to a specific store and under a specific department.
For this, let's move to the Customers tab.
To Add Store customers, click on the Add button on the Add Customer screen.
Select the store for the customer.
Select the department first name, last name, e-mail address, password, contact details, and company name if applicable.
If you want to assign any of the customers to a user group, select the user group from the drop down or you can create one and assign it through the plus icon.
Enter their address details and do the relevant settings.
Once done, click on Save and back.
On the main screen, you can see the customers added with the specific store and department assignment.
You can also add multiple store customers at once using the import feature as well as import the customer addresses with the import address feature.
Click on the import button and then download the file to enter the data.
In the next step, you can check the help for adding data in relevant fields.
The first name, e-mail address, password, and store ID are the mandatory details.
For adding the country, you need to add the country code instead of the country name.
You can refer to the country tab from the second step in search for the country to get the code.
Similarly, you need to add the store ID and state.
To activate the partial payment, you need to enter 1 and then to select the term you can refer to the payment term tab.
Once done, save the changes in the file and then upload it.
In the third step of the process, click on the import button to complete the import.
You can check and verify the details from the customers listing page.
You can create extra customer fields to get more information using the Extra fields button.
Lastly, in private stores there are some managerial approval requirements.
Let's say if an employee is placing an order first it should go to the manager for approval.
If the manager approves it only then it should go to the printer.
In case the manager rejects the order then it won't go to the printer.
We can set this kind of approval process in our system with a multi level hierarchy.

To set this, click on the Access Roles button, select the person to whom you want to give a managerial role, click on Allow access for a specific department or all departments and click on Order approval permission.
So here you can see the multi level hierarchy if you have created a person as a super approver.
Thus whenever any employee places an order, it will first go to the manager and if the manager approves it then only it will fall in the printer's grid.
Also, for the manager's approval, they don't need to log into the system every time they receive an e-mail.
They can directly approve it from e-mail without logging into their system.
And you have successfully created departments and customers for your private store with access roles.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
